Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: Prompt Seen showcase image for case 02
Primary request: Professional e-commerce photo of a matte white wireless speaker centered on pure white; soft even studio light; subtle contact shadow; keep an unbranded satin label and realistic surface texture sharp and true; front-facing, full product in frame, no props, no generated text.
Subject: 纯白背景电商主图
Constraints: make this one distinct image for this case; preserve the requested composition and subject; no readable generated text, no logos, no watermark; do not reuse a stock composition or another case's image.
Avoid: duplicate objects, collage, unrelated props, distorted geometry.
